title: Command palette
description: Search lessons, scenes, intro chapters, and settings. Press Enter to run, Esc to close.

shortcuts.title: Lab shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Available in the Lab scene when no run is in progress. Ignored while an input, slider, or dropdown has focus, or while Ctrl / ⌘ / Alt is held.
shortcuts.guide: While a guided tour replay is playing, ← / → switch between explanations.

items.jump-back: Back about 1 second in real time
items.jump-forward: Forward about 1 second in real time
items.slower: Previous replay pacing (Uniform / Real 1× / Real 2×, wraps around)
items.faster: Next replay pacing (Uniform / Real 1× / Real 2×, wraps around)
